title: Three more models for text, images, and reasoning
summary:
Three models, more video reference options, two community apps, and a CLI that checks the folder before sending the request.

Quest contributions added paid-only Nex N2.5 Pro, Nex N2.5 Mini, and Mistral Large 4. All three accept image input and support reasoning; Pro and Mistral Large 4 also support tool calling.

The SDK now accepts image, video, and audio reference URLs for video generation, either individually or as arrays. Its existing first- and last-frame image option still works.

SoloForge AI joined the build listing with a workflow from content ideas to generated assets and publishing. Audio joined the video and audio listing with text-to-speech. New app submissions now include Pollinations credit, a platform, and a screenshot.

highlights.title: Two Nex reasoning models
highlights.text: Try paid-only `nex-agi/nex-n2.5-pro` and `nex-agi/nex-n2.5-mini` with text or image input. Pro also supports tool calling. [Explore text models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models).

highlights.title: Mistral Large 4 added
highlights.text: Use paid-only Mistral Large 4 for text and image input, reasoning, and tool calling. [Explore text models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models).

highlights.title: More video reference options
highlights.text: Pass image, video, or audio reference URLs to video generation through the SDK, including arrays of URLs. [Explore the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).

highlights.title: SoloForge AI joins the catalog
highlights.text: Turn content ideas into generated assets, review them, and organize publishing workflows with Pollinations image generation. [Try it](https://soloforge-ai-web.onrender.com).

highlights.title: Audio joins the catalog
highlights.text: Try this community text-to-speech app; its BYOP access requires sign-in. [Try it](https://dwikatmahmoud87-source.github.io/Gtdcg).
